arStrings.szText: {c_important}Concussive Stomp{/c} grants a {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c} equal to {c_number}[{SF_13} * 100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([PlayerHealthMax() * SF_13]){/c} per enemy hit for {c_number}{buffduration:BARRIER}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_13} * {SF_14} * 100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Concussive Stomp{/c} grants you {c_number}[SF_26*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction for {c_number}[SF_27]{/c} seconds. When enemies recover from a {c_important}Concussive Stomp{/c}, they have {c_number}[SF_8 * 100|%|]{/c} reduced Attack Speed for {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Concussive Stomp{/c} hits in a circle around you and deals {c_number}[{SF_11}*100|%|]{/c} increased damage to {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} enemies and Bosses.

{c_important}Concussive Stomp{/c} becomes an {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill, deals Lightning damage, and has a {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} second Cooldown.

{c_important}Concussive Stomp{/c} electrifies the ground, Sparking enemies for {c_number}{dot:DOT}{/c} Damage over {c_number}{SF_19}{/c} seconds and causing them to drop a {c_important}{u}Storm Feather{/u}{/c}.
